title: MercyMed of Columbus
description: mercymedcolumbus.com zoominfo.com/c/mercymed-of-columbus/409041268 MercyMed of Columbus, Inc. is a 501(c)(3) nonprofit community health center founded in 2011 by Dr. Grant Scarborough, MD in Columbus, Georgia, serving uninsured and low-income patients across 4 clinics. It employs 32–85 staff plus ~150 volunteers and generated ~$2.5–3.9M in revenue (2024), providing $1.5–1.7M in free care annually — with 80¢ of every dollar going directly to programs. In 2024 it served 7,000+ patients with 20,729 primary care visits, 3,799 dental visits, and 1,566 prescriptions filled, including through its own in-house pharmacy (opened 2024). Services span family medicine, pediatrics, dentistry, ophthalmology, physical therapy, mental health counseling, and nutrition — with sliding-scale fees starting at $35/visit and completely free care for the homeless. A standout program is MercyMed Farm (since 2018), producing 18,000 lbs of organic vegetables/year for patients through SNAP-matched
